subject: Maine Coon
fact: Maine coons are large cats with thick coats and bushy tails.

subject: Siamese
fact: Siamese cats often have pale bodies with darker ears, faces, paws, and tails.

subject: Persian
fact: Persian cats are known for long fur and round faces.

subject: Ragdoll
fact: Ragdolls are large gentle cats with soft coats and blue eyes.

subject: Bengal
fact: Bengal cats have spotted or marbled coats that can resemble wild cats.

subject: British Shorthair
fact: British shorthairs have dense plush coats and round faces.

subject: Sphynx
fact: Sphynx cats have very little fur and need help staying warm.

subject: Scottish Fold
fact: Scottish folds are known for ears that can fold forward.

subject: Abyssinian
fact: Abyssinians are active cats with ticked coats where each hair has bands of color.

subject: American Shorthair
fact: American shorthairs are sturdy cats known for many coat colors and patterns.

subject: Norwegian Forest Cat
fact: Norwegian forest cats have thick water-resistant coats suited to cold climates.

subject: Birman
fact: Birmans are long-haired cats known for white paws and blue eyes.

subject: Russian Blue
fact: Russian blues have short dense coats and bright green eyes.

subject: Oriental Shorthair
fact: Oriental shorthairs have long bodies, large ears, and many coat colors.

subject: Devon Rex
fact: Devon rex cats have short curly coats and very large ears.

subject: Cornish Rex
fact: Cornish rex cats have soft wavy coats with almost no guard hairs.

subject: Manx
fact: Manx cats are known for naturally short or absent tails.

subject: Turkish Angora
fact: Turkish angoras are elegant cats with silky coats and long plumed tails.

subject: Turkish Van
fact: Turkish vans are strong swimmers and often have color mainly on the head and tail.

subject: Egyptian Mau
fact: Egyptian maus are naturally spotted domestic cats.

subject: Ocicat
fact: Ocicats have wild-looking spots but are fully domestic cats.

subject: Savannah
fact: Savannah cats are tall, long-legged cats descended from domestic cats and servals.

subject: American Curl
fact: American curls are named for ears that curl backward.

subject: Selkirk Rex
fact: Selkirk rex cats can have plush curly coats and whiskers.

subject: Himalayan
fact: Himalayans combine long Persian-like coats with pointed coloring.

subject: Balinese
fact: Balinese cats are long-haired relatives of Siamese cats.

subject: Bombay
fact: Bombay cats were developed to have sleek black coats and copper-colored eyes.

subject: Burmese
fact: Burmese cats are muscular, social cats with short glossy coats.

subject: Tonkinese
fact: Tonkinese cats combine traits from Siamese and Burmese ancestors.

subject: Chartreux
fact: Chartreux cats are known for blue-gray coats and copper or gold eyes.

subject: Ragamuffin
fact: Ragamuffins are large affectionate cats with soft plush coats.

subject: Somali
fact: Somalis are long-haired relatives of Abyssinians with fluffy tails.

subject: Japanese Bobtail
fact: Japanese bobtails have naturally short tails that can look like pom-poms.

subject: American Bobtail
fact: American bobtails have naturally shortened tails and sturdy bodies.

subject: LaPerm
fact: LaPerm cats have curly coats that can range from loose waves to tight ringlets.

subject: Singapura
fact: Singapuras are one of the smallest recognized cat breeds.

subject: Snowshoe
fact: Snowshoe cats often have white paws and pointed coloring.

subject: Toyger
fact: Toygers were bred for striped coats that resemble tiny tigers.

subject: Pixiebob
fact: Pixiebobs are sturdy cats often seen with short tails.

subject: Munchkin
fact: Munchkin cats have naturally short legs caused by a genetic trait.

subject: Nebelung
fact: Nebelungs have long blue-gray coats and green eyes.

subject: Siberian
fact: Siberian cats have thick triple coats suited to cold weather.

subject: Korat
fact: Korats are silver-blue cats from Thailand with heart-shaped faces.

subject: Havana Brown
fact: Havana browns are known for rich brown coats and green eyes.

subject: European Shorthair
fact: European shorthairs are sturdy cats with many traditional coat colors.

subject: Exotic Shorthair
fact: Exotic shorthairs have round Persian-like faces but short plush coats.

subject: Chausie
fact: Chausies are tall athletic cats descended partly from jungle cats.

subject: Lykoi
fact: Lykoi cats have sparse coats that can give them a werewolf-like appearance.

subject: Peterbald
fact: Peterbald cats may be hairless or have very short fine coats.

subject: Burmilla
fact: Burmillas often have silver coats with darker shading at the tips.

subject: Colorpoint Shorthair
fact: Colorpoint shorthairs are closely related to Siamese cats and come in many point colors.

subject: Cymric
fact: Cymrics are long-haired relatives of Manx cats and often have very short tails.

subject: Foldex
fact: Foldex cats combine folded ears with a round, compact face shape.

subject: Khao Manee
fact: Khao manee cats from Thailand are known for white coats and bright eyes.

subject: Kurilian Bobtail
fact: Kurilian bobtails have naturally short tails and strong hind legs.

subject: Mekong Bobtail
fact: Mekong bobtails are pointed cats with short kinked tails.

subject: Oriental Longhair
fact: Oriental longhairs have slender bodies, large ears, and flowing coats.

subject: Thai Cat
fact: Thai cats resemble the traditional rounder form of early Siamese cats.

subject: Tuxedo Cat
fact: Tuxedo cats have black-and-white markings that can resemble formal clothing.

subject: Tabby Cat
fact: Tabby is a coat pattern featuring stripes, spots, or swirls rather than a single breed.
